purpose: Select the most redistributable and auditable paper-data route as the manuscript primary analysis while retaining biological-unit, target-rich and technical-replicate sensitivities without pooling incompatible estimands.

primary_route.negative_control: 256 within-development-batch target permutations with frozen selected alpha
primary_route.claim_boundary: Primary paper-data portability analysis only. Dalian is pooled/unspecified plasma and Edinburgh donor IDs are not encoded in the current map; laboratory-anchor count is not treated as donor-level biological replication.

secondary_routes.claim_boundary: Analysis-only because one source is CC-BY-NC-ND and another has unresolved redistribution status; biological-unit clustering is reported but does not create independent external validation.
Target-rich paper-data sensitivity with source-local ranks; it is not pooled with T195 and does not resolve donor-level independence.
Technical-replicate-aware author-side refit; its four-source target panel and estimand remain separate from the T195 primary route.

non_pooling_rules: Do not concatenate raw abundance scales across studies.
Do not pool fold metrics, p-values, biological-unit counts or target universes across T195, T265, T193 and T277.
Report laboratory/source anchor, study, biological-unit, batch and row denominators separately.
Do not call any paper-data route a non-author lockbox, no-author reproduction or external adoption receipt.
decision: Use T195 as the manuscript primary redistributable common-target analysis; use T265, T193 and T277 as explicitly labeled sensitivities. This improves the paper-data evidence hierarchy but does not close the external gates.
